generated.description: A large cluster of multi-story fraternity-style houses built from spruce planks, gray wool, smooth stone and quartz, with a mix of stone brick, brick and nether brick accents and a few glass-paned windows. The complex is about 103 blocks wide, 28 high and 44 deep, and contains around 10,400 blocks; the source gives no description of any interior details beyond a skull block entity.
